79 Re M (A Child: Intermediaries) [2025] EWCA Civ 440

80 Practice Guidance by the PFD: “The use of Intermediaries, Lay Advocates and Cognitive Assessments in the
Family Court” (Jan 2025). Re M made a correction to the approach to be taken to the instruction of
intermediaries. Courts should no longer rely upon paras. 8, 10 and 12.

81 See “Practice Guidance by the PFD: The use of Intermediaries, Lay Advocates and Cognitive Assessments in
the Family Court” (January 2025). The term “intermediary” in the Guidance also includes a “lay advocate”.
